latest_changelog.zh_cn:
- 市民挨饿太久会启动新的寻找食物状态，在殖民地内找未加入食物黑名单的食物进食
- 修复了合成系统显示与高版本不兼容的问题
- 支持的版本上调至（1.20.1 - 1197 / 1.21.1 - 1285）
- 这里只是更新日志摘要，详情见CurseForge/Modrinth主页视频和文件的更新日志
latest_changelog.en_us:
- **Added fallback eating transitions for citizens when they are starving, they'll search for any edible food available.**
- Fixed a bug causing incorrect recipe counts in newer MineColonies versions
- Raised the supported MineColonies dependency version to (1.20.1 - 1197 / 1.21.1 - 1285)
- This is only a brief summary. See full changelog on the CurseForge/Modrinth page for details.
